features: Named Mir programme and 2026 launch licensing acknowledged by Korea AeroSpace Administration notice.

2023 Defence Ministry published a final four-stage programme concept with a cylindrical first stage, upper stages and pointed fairing; its illustration is reproduced by Maeil Business News with Ministry attribution.
coverage.limitations: Source-dated programme representative only, not engineering geometry or a specific launch livery; no source pixels, lettering or national markings copied. Stage lengths, widths, joints, nozzle and final integrated exterior are approximate; test missions have differed and a future flight configuration is not established.
